editorial:
Imagine feeling like a total nobody at your job and coming home to a life that feels just as dull. That is exactly where you find the main guy in this quirky old comedy. He is just an average worker who is tired of being pushed around, so he starts daydreaming about becoming a powerful dictator. While he is plotting his imaginary takeover, his aunt is off in her own world, hoping a magician from a fairground will suddenly show up and sweep her off her feet again. It is a funny, lighthearted look at how people use their imaginations to escape their boring daily routines.

You will probably love the goofy energy and the way the movie jumps between these weird fantasies. The acting is charming and keeps the mood light, though some parts might feel a bit slow since it is from 1938. If you enjoy old-school humor, you should definitely give this a shot. Since it is a vintage gem, your best bet is to hunt for a restored version. You can try renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection to get the best picture possible for your home theater.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the main character realizes that his dreams of power are just a way to hide his insecurity. He stops pretending to be a dictator and learns to find happiness in his real life. Meanwhile, the aunt finally gets a sense of closure regarding her lost love. The movie wraps up with a sweet lesson that being yourself is better than living in a fake fantasy world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic cinema and stories about daydreams.
